HERO TRUMPO: KIDLAT. A real recognizable Filipino wooden spinning top, squat pear-shaped turned-wood body, short upper winding peg and sharp single steel tip pointing downward, shown in dramatic elevated three-quarter view. Midnight navy lacquer #1d3557 with sharp golden yellow #ffd23f lightning inlays. The body has angular lightning-bolt armor bands and a crown-like storm cap, small burned wood scars. A compact electric-gold lightning halo wraps the top, two or three thick readable bolts and a few sparks. Feel: fearless high-damage thunder champion. The spinning top itself is the clear dominant subject; don't hide it in effects.
